semantic_constraints.statement: PARTIAL/UNKNOWN recovery cannot make the unrelated/current document globally readonly
DISCOVER has zero image calls; START/STEP require explicit current user intent
paid/recovery mutations bind to confirmed DraftRecord identity
save success requires CAS plus physical readback
whole-work export authority belongs to final materialized pages after copy coverage and quality checks
